label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.103…: In the execution of government GOD_2 governs some…
locator: I q.103 a.6 co.: in its execution, He governs some things by means of others
interpretation: In the execution of government God governs some things by means of others, making some 'causes of others in government'. Kept as prose. It supports, without stating, the open bridge STMT-DIRECTION-THROUGH-INTERMEDIARIES, which generalizes to every mover of a director (Codex P1 on #196: a.6 does not make every incidental mover of a governing cause a governor of its effects). Basis: the English Dominican translation (web snapshot); a candidate for upgrade once a pinned Latin witness of q.103 exists.
